question: Does the test-backed distinction between a held lease and a genuine failed exact review provide sufficient confidence to merge this workflow coordination change now?
rationale: The patch is narrow and the listed checks pass, but the changed behavior coordinates durable queue ownership with GitHub Actions status reporting under an operational race that unit and source-order tests cannot fully emulate.

options.title: Accept the guarded coordination change
options.body: Merge with the focused policy and tests, relying on durable-queue retry ownership and normal production observation for the next contention event.

options.title: Require a controlled held-lease trace
options.body: Keep the PR open until a maintainer captures one redacted Actions/durable-queue trace showing the held lease becomes deferred rather than falsely red.

recommendation.title: Accept the guarded coordination change
recommendation.body: Merge with the focused policy and tests, relying on durable-queue retry ownership and normal production observation for the next contention event.
